conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions. Expect lower volatility but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while introducing new, high-scoring long setups. Expect moderate growth with controlled risk, but market swings can still impact returns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware that this approach significantly amplifies both potential gains and drawdowns, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay and rebalancing.
